name: flowbuddy-vscode
description: Tells the local Flow Buddy daemon whether the editor has focus, vscodevim's mode and how the cursor moved. Numbers and flags only; nothing leaves your machine.

commands.title: Practice (a two-minute drill in Vim: pick one)

enumDescriptions: Flow Buddy's card on the desktop, with the whole tip, what it does and the answers (from the top bar on GNOME, a notification elsewhere). With an editor-only install there's no desktop card, so tips show as VS Code notifications
A VS Code notification at the bottom right, with Got it and Not helpful, and the tip in the status bar
Only VS Code's status bar, highlighted, for a few seconds
flowbuddy.tips.description: How Flow Buddy's tips show in VS Code.

flowbuddy.startDaemon.description: Start Flow Buddy's daemon when it isn't running and no service runs it (an editor-only install). It reads no keyboard, and exits by itself ten minutes after the last editor closes.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Flow Buddy
walkthroughs.description: A Vim coach: tips for shorter ways to do what you just did, a daily lesson, and drills.
